description: This Java class 'StartSwapView' extends 'SwapView' and manages UI components and interactions for nearby peer swapping, including Bluetooth and Wi-Fi management, in the FDroid app.

classes.name: PeopleNearbyAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying nearby peers in a list.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Removes listeners and unregisters receivers when view is detached.

methods.name: onFinishInflate
methods.description: Initializes UI components after layout inflation.

methods.name: uiInitButtons
methods.description: Sets up the send FDroid button.

methods.name: uiInitPeers
methods.description: Initializes the list of nearby peers and its adapter.

methods.name: uiInitBluetooth
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth UI elements and state.

methods.name: onBluetoothSwitchToggled
methods.description: Handles toggling of Bluetooth visibility switch.

methods.name: onPeerSelected
methods.description: Handles user selecting a peer from the list.
